Private Aircraft "High Roller" Terminals at LAS

Offering Procedures

Cushman & Wakefield, Inc. ("C&W") is contacting prospective purchasers in order to solicit their interest in the acquisition of The Site on Las Vegas Strip. The Property is being offered on a strict "as-is" basis with the selection of the buyer being influenced by the level of physical and economic due diligence
initially undertaken by prospective purchasers. In this regard, detailed financial information, title reports, service contracts and other relevant documentation are available for review.

Property Tours

Prospective purchasers are asked to contact C&W to arrange specific times for property tours.

Offer Submission

Prospective purchasers are kindly requested to submit offers to Cushman & Wakefield at their earliest convenience but no later than XX, XX, XXXX at the address specified below:
